name: gpu-vllm-t4-2b-w4a16
description: Manage vLLM serving of Gemma 4 E2B as 4-bit weights end to end (xbill9/gemma-4-E2B-it-qat-q4_0-w4a16-ct-text-emb4: QAT W4A16 with int4 embeddings, text only) on one NVIDIA Tesla T4 (Turing, SM 7.5) already attached to a Compute Engine VM, via the gpu-vllm-t4-2b-w4a16 MCP server: host capacity across three filesystems, GPU architecture verification, the Triton shared-memory clamp Turing needs, server lifecycle and SRE diagnostics. Carries the repack tools that built the checkpoint. Forked from gpu-vllm-t4-2b 2026-09-29; slot 5 is the only difference. Measured: 2.86 GiB loaded, 1,099,362 KV tokens, 109.7 tok/s at c=1.
